name: fklua-ipcprobe
title: FkLua UDP IPC probe
author: FkLua
description: Measures what helpers.send_udp / helpers.recv_udp / on_udp_packet_received actually do on the installed Factorio, driven over the wire by scripts/ipc-probe-driver.py. Not a real mod; used only to calibrate the FkLua IPC protocol constants.
